figures.name: paper-dft
figures.title: How mathematics is used in the Discrete Fourier Transform and the Discrete Z-transform
figures.desc: Builds up the Discrete Fourier Transform and its complex form, derives the Z-transform from pure mathematics, and compares the two methods.

figures.name: paper-pendulum
figures.title: Deriving the equation of motion of a double pendulum
figures.desc: Derives the equations of motion with Lagrangian mechanics, then plots both masses for starting angles up to 120° to show where the motion turns chaotic.
